profile_config:
cli_auth_credentials_store="file"
web_search="disabled"
[features]
remote_plugin=false
apps=false
hooks=false
multi_agent=false
memories=false
external_agent_memory_import=false
[memories]
use_memories=false
generate_memories=false
[apps._default]
enabled=false
prompt: Do not call tools or read any file. Reply exactly SPECIALIST_ACCESS_OK.
permissions: read-only; existing-account copied authentication; no tool use requested
failure_policy: Record failure; do not substitute tuple, consume reset credits, or automatically retry. Continue independent implementation.
